hero.title: Versailles United Methodist Church
hero.subtitle: A Welcoming Church in Versailles, Kentucky
hero.text: We are a church in Versailles, Kentucky seeking to Love Like Jesus through worship, connection, service, and spiritual growth. Whether you are exploring faith, returning to church, or looking for a church home, there is a place for you here. #LoveLikeJesus

community_stories.title: Real stories from life at VUMC.
community_stories.text: Stories from guests, members, and neighbors help show what it means to Love Like Jesus through worship, welcome, fellowship, service, and community in Versailles, Kentucky.

who_we_are.title: More than a church. A calling.
who_we_are.text: At Versailles United Methodist Church, we are striving to Love Like Jesus. That means loving God, loving people, and living out our faith in real, everyday ways. It is not just something we say — it is who we are becoming.
